notes: Canonical FEHA firearm sheets now include the live Weapon Tracker controls directly inside the designed weapon page.
The sheet exposes ATTACK and DAMAGE through the same configured internal dnd5e activity used by the centered Weapon Tracker; raw activity rows remain hidden.
Reload controls are integrated in-sheet using the locked tabletop model: Action +2 reload points, Bonus Action +1 reload point, with live progress and attacks-remaining state.
UNDO SHOT, RESET TRACKER, and OPEN FLOATING HUD are available from the same page.
Actor-owned sheets use their own weapon copy. World/library weapon sheets resolve to the selected token or assigned character's matching owned canonical copy, preferring an equipped copy.
The in-sheet state refreshes after actions so remaining shots and reload progress update without closing the weapon page.
No firearm balance, manufacturer rules, armor, cyberware, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
